title: Betrayal!
reviewNotes: All 51 diagrams/captions re-reviewed, including native image18 at 65 seconds. Complete ten-piece later Kg5 root has a forced h4+/Kf5/g4+/hxg4/Rf4+/Bxf4/e4 mate proof. A separate native seven-piece pawn ending at image17/63 seconds is independently reconstructed; added g3/Kf5/e4+/Kg5 continuation is tablebase checked and explicitly independent. The two source roots are separate variations, not a joined score. Earlier eleven-piece Bf6+/Qxf6/Kd5+ defenses remain outside scope.
